Great little waterfront restaurant
Aug 2014 • Couples
Managed by R & R Tavern in Nigh Tam, Senso has the same extensive menu as R & R itself. Great range of cocktails, great location and easy to get to. The staff are the best asset of this place, friendly, helpful and delightful. Great place to sit on the street or by the lake for a drink or a meal inside the air conditioned restaurant.

A pleasant surprise
Feb 2014 • Solo
After three days in Hanoi staying and eating (mostly) at the Intercontinental and a little fed up with the same limited menu there, I took a walk around West Lake and came across this little place. Senso is a clean, unpretentious, friendly eatery in Quang An Road, just off Xuan Dieu (I told this is pronounced Swan Zeou!) with a really good food and wine selection. I had the mushroom and vegetable-stuffed fresh spring rolls for entrée. Great! Light, really fresh and served with a mildly spicy dipping sauce. For main, I had their New Zealand lamb and it was evident as soon as I smelt and tasted it that it had been cooked by someone who is an expert: honestly, I've eaten a lot of "European" or Asian-fusion dishes that show the chef is not great with meats like lamb but this dish was sensational. Turns out the Senso chef IS internationally experienced and recently left a new 5-star hotel in Hanoi. I had two glasses of a nice Australian white (can't remember the name). Very attentive and not at all overbearing service. Food came promptly and cleanly presented. The simple ice cream dessert I had topped this off nicely. Speaking to the manager, she told me the restaurant just opened after Vietnamese New Year and custom is picking up. I'd recommend you get in early to try this place. No stodge, no fatty cooking. Just great, fresh, simple food served well and enjoyed.
